lemma fun_iterated_deriv [CompleteSpace E] {n : ℕ} (hf : Meromorphic f) :
    Meromorphic (fun x ↦ _root_.deriv^[n] f x) := hf.iterated_deriv

example : Meromorphic (fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x) := by fun_prop

example (e : E) : Meromorphic (fun _ : 𝕜 ↦ e) := by fun_prop

example (hf : Meromorphic f) (e : E) : Meromorphic (fun x ↦ f x + e) := by fun_prop

example (h : Meromorphic (fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x)) : Meromorphic (fun x : 𝕜 ↦ x⁻¹) := by fun_prop
